name: ravenous_amulet_counts_its_soul_counters_as_it_is_sacrificed
notes: M8 mapper. Printed: '{4}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Each opponent loses life equal to the number of soul counters on this artifact.' Three players. The Amulet has three soul counters; seat 0 sacrifices it as the cost, and the ability counts its counters as the Amulet last existed on the battlefield (CR 608.2h): seats 1 and 2 lose 3 life each, seat 0 none.
